meta.name: wcag-audit-patterns
meta.description: Conduct WCAG 2.2 accessibility audits with automated testing, manual verification, and remediation guidance. Use when auditing websites for accessibility, fixing WCAG violations, or implementing accessible design patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计网站无障碍并给出修复建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站需要满足 WCAG 无障碍标准且不确定从何入手。
copy.tagline_en: Audit website accessibility and get fix guidance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your website accessible to people with disabilities and meet WCAG standards.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 WCAG 2.2 做无障碍审计:跑自动检测、列人工核验项,并给出修复建议,问题按 A/AA/AAA 等级和 POUR 原则归类。
howto.when: 当你要审计网站无障碍、修复 WCAG 违规,或实现无障碍设计模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我按 WCAG 2.2 AA 审计这个页面,列出问题
say.note: 会按等级列出违规项与修复建议

say.text: 这个表单缺少标签,告诉我怎么修
say.note: 会说明表单标签的修复方式

say.text: 检查我们首页的颜色对比度和键盘可达性
say.note: 会指出对比度与键盘访问问题

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude audits pages against WCAG 2.2: it runs automated checks, adds manual verification steps, and gives remediation guidance, grouping issues by A/AA/AAA level and the POUR principles.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you audit a site for accessibility, fix WCAG violations, or implement accessible design patterns.

say_en.text: Audit this page against WCAG 2.2 AA and list the issues
say_en.note: Returns violations by severity with fixes

say_en.text: This form has no labels - show me how to fix it
say_en.note: Explains label fixes for form fields

say_en.text: Check our homepage for color contrast and keyboard access
